runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 17:55 sweep across 12 actually searched source families. No new unique promotion-grade LIVE item was added. LinkedIn again surfaced NATEK Salesforce CRM Support Manager, rejected for senior Salesforce ownership, and SupportYourApp technical support, rejected for C1/fluent English and higher infrastructure scope. Upwork surfaced a new Worldwide beginner VA/admin listing with Slovak among accepted languages and a 1,500 USD fixed price, but the client account was created the same day and has no established hiring/spend history, so it was not promoted. Reddit/WordPress community results were supply-side or US-only. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts with direct links.

developmentChanges.title: Source query-to-result observability ledger
developmentChanges.reason: For every source family persist the actual query count, concrete result count and canonical-detail opens. This separates a genuine zero-result market from search-index starvation or a blocked parser, improves audit truthfulness and prevents a source being marked healthy merely because a query was issued.

developmentChanges.title: Application-channel liveness verifier
developmentChanges.reason: Before a high-ranked job is promoted or re-notified, verify in the same run that its apply route, public contact or application form is still reachable. A live-looking listing with a dead apply path should remain verification-only, saving time on stale vacancies and improving reaction success.
